privacy_constraints.minimum_fields_only: Request only the fields listed above; redact secrets before sharing. If client IP or user identifiers are sensitive, provide them only if policy allows and redact other PII.

evidence_questions: Did the original client request that created transaction record_id=97b76766-d13a-4db6-8baf-572292b83913 contain amount_cents = 1000000 while the DB contains 100000000?
If multiple candidate requests exist, which request correlates to the DB insert/create event? Provide request_id/correlation_id/trace_id that links request -> DB transaction.
Was the request handled by a frontend/backend build/version known to have a currency ×100 scaling bug? Provide build IDs if available.

case_A.action: Escalate to human reviewers with the preserved log evidence. Do NOT perform DB mutation automatically.

case_B.interpretation: No client-side ×100 evidence; transaction likely legitimate
case_B.action: Keep under review; investigate other causes.

case_C.action: Maintain LIKELY_CORRUPTED / HIGH and retain NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE.

case_D.interpretation: Correlate request_id/transaction_id/trace to DB insert event
case_D.action: Document which request created the DB row; do not assume the earliest hit.

case_E.condition: Evidence shows frontend build with ×100 bug
case_E.action: Escalate for human approval; do not auto-correct.

escalation_conditions: Case A or Case E -> escalate to recovery reviewers and product/engineering
Provide preserved, unmodified log excerpts and correlation IDs.
phase_e6_blockers: No approval manifest listing candidate with original/proposed values
safety_statement: This request is read-only. No database mutation is authorized or requested. Preserve original logs; redact secrets/tokens/passwords/cookies/unrelated PII. Provide only the fields requested.
notes_for_operator: If logs are stored in multiple systems (ingress/proxy, CDN, API gateway, backend app, SIEM), search all those sources and correlate using request_id/correlation_id/trace_id and timestamps. If request bodies are retained only in short-term storage and outside retention, please state retention window and whether retrieval is possible. Do not modify or transform original logs beyond redaction of secrets.
